game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater, a breakwater in a storm: the shipwright must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Signal Logic: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings.
theme: Coastal Port – Storm Breakwater: a breakwater in a storm
core_gameplay_loop: In Storm Breakwater, repeat each round: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the safety value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the lighthouse lamp using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The lighthouse lamp reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the lighthouse lamp is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Signal Logic
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Signal Logic' (Week 3 slot 9), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Storm Breakwater'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Storm Breakwater.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The lighthouse lamp reached with actions_used <= 23.
